_about: Regression layer (R/regression.R): runs when analysis.model has covariate terms (role covariate). Biodes may set analysis.regression = {predict_at: [{term or covariate name: value}], robust: none | mm, order_column: column for Durbin-Watson}. Checks are reported, never used to switch the model.
_note_std_residual_cut: |standardized residual| > 3: possible outlier (datanovia linear and logistic diagnostics)
_note_cooks: Cook's distance > 4/(n - p - 1) flags influence; > cooks_large is strong influence (the 0.5 contour of plot(model, 5))
_note_vif: VIF > 5 (lenient 10) problematic; factors: GVIF^(1/(2 df)) squared is compared
_note_sensitivity: the partial f2 (and slope) detectable with this power at alpha given the residual df (pwr::pwr.f2.test); observed power is never reported (datanovia power page)
_note_min_epv: logistic: events in the smaller outcome class per coefficient
reference: Fox & Weisberg 2019 An R Companion to Applied Regression (car); Cook 1977 Technometrics 19:15; Breusch & Pagan 1979 Econometrica 47:1287; Ramsey 1969 JRSS B 31:350; MacKinnon & White 1985 J Econometrics 29:305 (HC3); Hosmer & Lemeshow 2013 Applied Logistic Regression; Box & Tidwell 1962 Technometrics 4:531; Nagelkerke 1991 Biometrika 78:691; Cohen 1988 (f2); datanovia regression tutorials
_note_influence_change_se: refit without the unit with the largest Cook's distance: a coefficient that moves more than this many standard errors is flagged (the change in % is reported too)
